answer: LIST st, ci, zp, sta FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t AND ALSO (g / t) AS r AND ALSO has SchoolStreet st AND ALSO has SchoolCity ci AND ALSO has SchoolZip zp AND ALSO has SchoolState sta WHERE t > 0 ORDERED WITH r ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST n, e FROM Frpm [has SchoolDOC: '31'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e ORDERED WITH e DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST g FROM School has SchoolLongitude lo AND ALSO abs(lo) AS a AND ALSO has SchoolGSoffered g ORDERED WITH a DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, dt FROM Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a AND ALSO has SchoolDOCType dt WHERE (k - a) > THE AVERAGE d IN (Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2 AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2 AND ALSO (k2 - a2) AS d)
LIST n FROM Frpm has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmFreeMealCountK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e AND ALSO (k/e) AS p AND ALSO has SatscoreNumGE1500 g WHERE p > 0.1 AND g > 0
LIST c, n FROM School s [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty c WHERE c = 'San Diego' OR c = 'Santa Barbara' AND ALSO THE COUNT OF s GROUPED BY c AS n ORDERED WITH n DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
